# Let me check the current state of all relevant blocks

print("=== Current blocks ===")
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['pixels'] > 1 and n['color'] not in ['c', 'G', 'w', 'W', 'B']:
        boundary = n['boundary']
        min_row = min(p[0] for p in boundary)
        min_col = min(p[1] for p in boundary)
        max_row = max(p[0] for p in boundary)
        max_col = max(p[1] for p in boundary)
        print(f"  color={n['color']}, {n['pixels']}px, ({min_row},{min_col})-({max_row},{max_col})")

print("\n=== Initial blocks ===")

    if n['pixels'] > 1 and n['color'] not in ['c', 'G', 'w', 'W', 'B']:
        boundary = n['boundary']
        min_row = min(p[0] for p in boundary)
        min_col = min(p[1] for p in boundary)
        max_row = max(p[0] for p in boundary)
        max_col = max(p[1] for p in boundary)
        print(f"  color={n['color']}, {n['pixels']}px, ({min_row},{min_col})-({max_row},{max_col})")

result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 19, 'col': 48}])
print(f"\nClick red cross: board_changed={result.get('board_changed')}")

# Check the red block position after
for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'R':
        boundary = n['boundary']
        min_row = min(p[0] for p in boundary)
        min_col = min(p[1] for p in boundary)

        max_col = max(p[1] for p in boundary)
        print(f"Red block now: ({min_row},{min_col})-({max_row},{max_col}), {n['pixels']}px")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
